request: Could you please check behind the TV for my coaster?
description: search for the coaster, hinting that it is behind the TV
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Fallback>
            <IsVisible object="coaster" />
            <SearchFor object="coaster" hint="behind the TV" />
        </Fallback>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

request: I'm parched and my cup is sitting somewhere across the room.
